text: Cultivate research-oriented, application-oriented and high-level talents who meet the needs of national and local economic and social development. Have political literacy and sense of mission, have broad basic theoretical knowledge and skills in chemistry, systematically master the professional knowledge, theory and research methods of chemistry disciplines, and understand its current situation and development trend. Have good scientific literacy and the ability to engage in scientific research, and have a strong sense of innovation and application. Have the ability to use the first foreign Chinese for literature reading and academic communication, initially have the ability to write foreign language scientific research papers, and be proficient in the use of computers and modern information tools.
